newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China to adopt new share listing quota system.
newsitem.headline: China to adopt new share listing quota system.

text.p: The Securities Commission of the State Council plans to reform the current share quota system to improve the overall quality of the country's equity markets, the official Securities Times said on Thursday.

Under the existing system, stock listings are determined by quotas allocated to provinces, cities and ministries, which tend to distribute them to a number of smaller firms rather than to fewer big enterprises, the paper said.

Under the new system, the State Planning Commission and Securities Commission of the State Council would fix an annual share quota and the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) would decide which province, city and ministry is allowed to recommend firms for share issues, the paper said.
The CSRC would examine candidates before they are approved to make sure the number of new shares offered does not exceed the annual quota.
